The '''Ragnos Lakes''' were a location on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], named by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] castaway group known as the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Lost Tribe]] after the former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Marka Ragnos]]. Surrounded by eight villages, the farthest from the [[Tahv|center]] of Sith power on Kesh being [[Tetsubal]], the area played host to the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of thousands of local [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] in [[4985 BBY]] at the hands of the Sith [[Ravilan Wroth]] and, without his knowledge, prominent Sith [[Seelah Korsin]]. As a result, the region was abandoned.

==Description==
{{Quote|There are eight villages on various bodies of water, each with different specimens to examine.|Ravilan Wroth|<ref name="paragon" />}}
The Ragnos Lakes were a group of lakes on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] to the south of one of the world's major [[City/Legends|cities]], [[Tahv]]. The lakes were surrounded by eight villages, including [[Tetsubal]] and [[Rabolow]], containing hundreds of thousands of [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] natives. The lakes themselves were home to a several different types of [[fluorescent algae]].<ref name="paragon" />

==History==
{{Dialogue|Messenger|Grand Lord. It&hellip;has happened again&hellip;''in Rabolow!''|Ravilan Wroth|Rabolow?|Seelah Korsin|That's on the Ragnos Lakes, isn't it? That's where your people were assigned to go yesterday, wasn't it, Ravilan? Villages on the Ragnos Lakes.|attr=A Lost Tribe [[Unidentified messenger|messenger]], Ravilan Wroth, and Seelah Korsin, after the massacre in Rabolow|src=<ref name="paragon" />}}
In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] crash-landed on Kesh, the crew of a wayward [[Starship/Legends|starship]] known as the ''[[Omen]]''. The [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], as the survivors were known, quickly took over the planet,<ref name="skyborn">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]''</ref> naming the lakes after the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Marka Ragnos]]. In [[4985 BBY]], the local Keshiri residents began harvesting a kind of fluorescent algae from the Ragnos Lakes. Lost Tribe leader [[Yaru Korsin]] sent one of his [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]], [[Ravilan Wroth]], to the area to discern whether the algae could be used for lighting Sith structures. Wroth, who desired to escape seclusion on Kesh, decided to use the opportunity to convince the Sith to withdraw from Keshiri matters and focus on finding a way off the planet. Using the deadly compound [[cyanogen silicate]], he and several accomplices [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] the [[Water/Legends|water]] supply of Tetsubal, killing the entire Keshiri population. However, Wroth's misdeeds were discovered, and Yaru Korsin's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Seelah Korsin|Seelah]] conspired to poison the rest of the Ragnos Lakes villages and frame Wroth. Her plan went off without a hitch, and Wroth and the other members of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] on Kesh were systematically [[Red Sith Purge|purged]] from Kesh as a result.<ref name="paragon" /> The Ragnos Lakes region was subsequently abandoned, with its empty settlements regarded as ghost towns<ref name="purgatory">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Purgatory]]''</ref>&mdash;by [[3960 BBY]], the area was commonly believed to be haunted.<ref name="sentinel">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ragnos Lakes are mentioned in three [[eBook]]s by [[John Jackson Miller]]&mdash;''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]'',<ref name="paragon" /> [[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Purgatory|''Purgatory'']],<ref name="purgatory" /> and [[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel|''Sentinel'']].<ref name="sentinel" /> However, the lakes themselves have not appeared.
